settings.heading: What should I wear during my massage?
settings.row_content: You'll be undressed to your comfort level and fully draped with a sheet throughout your session — only the area being worked on is ever uncovered.

settings.heading: How early should I arrive for my appointment?
settings.row_content: Please arrive 10–15 minutes before your scheduled time to fill out a short intake form and settle in.

settings.heading: What is your cancellation policy?
settings.row_content: We kindly ask for at least 24 hours' notice if you need to cancel or reschedule. Late cancellations and no-shows may be subject to a fee.

settings.heading: Do you accept insurance?
settings.row_content: We don't bill insurance directly, but we're happy to provide a receipt you can submit for reimbursement if your plan covers massage therapy.

settings.heading: Do you offer gift cards?
settings.row_content: Yes! Gift cards are available for any service and make a wonderful gift. Contact us to purchase one.

settings.heading: Is massage safe during pregnancy?
settings.row_content: Yes — our prenatal massage is designed specifically for expectant mothers. Let us know if you're pregnant when booking so we can tailor your session.

settings.heading: What if I have an injury or medical condition?
settings.row_content: Let us know about any injuries, medical conditions, or areas of concern before your session so we can adjust pressure and technique accordingly.

settings.text: We're happy to help — reach out any time.
